tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything: page background and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, the topbar. The default ground for content.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers, hovered rows, segmented-control tracks, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs that float above surface (pair with shadow-lg).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card outlines, dividers, table rules. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, switches and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-subtle in both themes.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-subtle, surface-overlay and primary-soft.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, hints, table metadata, placeholders. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface, surface-subtle and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; never use for content.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand blue: primary buttons, active nav, links, selected states, focus. As text it reads on bg, surface, surface-subtle and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the active nav item, selected rows, info alerts and primary badges.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on any primary fill (primary, primary-hover, primary-pressed). Dark in the dark theme because the fill is light.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons; on surface, bg and success-soft. Always paired with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status text and icons; on surface, bg and warning-soft. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; text on surface, bg and danger-soft, and the fill of the danger button.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error badges, alerts and the invalid-field message area.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status; an alias of primary so info never introduces a second blue.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info alerts; alias of primary-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color (see the focus-ring shadow). Holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; alias of primary.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display and headings
groups.note: Semibold, tight tracking as size grows. One display per page at most.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and empty-state headlines. Never inside app chrome.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title, once per page, top-left of the content area.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles within a page; dialog titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: 14px is the working size of the product UI.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Invite your team and start tracking work in minutes.
styles.usage: Long-form reading: docs, onboarding, sign-in copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your workspace has 12 active members and 3 pending invites.
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, descriptions, form values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button labels at small size, nav items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps, helper and error text under fields.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and above stat values.

groups.name: Numbers and code
groups.note: Tabular figures for anything compared in a column.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The big number in a stat card (sans, tabular figures).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API keys, IDs, inline code and code blocks.

spacing.note: 4px base. Inside components use 1 to 4; between components 4 to 8; between page sections 8 to 16.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its input; between stacked buttons in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small buttons and inputs; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of medium controls; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense screens; sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Dialog padding on wide screens; top margin above a page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; spacing between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing sections and auth layouts only.

radius.note: Soft, not round. Radius grows with the size of the thing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, tooltips, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, alerts, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, status dots, pill badges.

shadow.note: Elevation is quiet: borders carry structure, shadows only say something floats. Darker and tighter in the dark theme.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards with the elevated variant; the topbar when scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered interactive cards; dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, command palette, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px surface gap, then a solid 2px primary ring. Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius.

size.note: Fixed dimensions for controls and app chrome.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and inputs: table toolbars, dense filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons and inputs: auth forms, touch-first screens (meets the 44px touch target).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small controls and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size: nav, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: App topbar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page content column.
